meta.name: seo-cluster
meta.description: SERP-based semantic topic clustering for content architecture planning. Groups keywords by actual Google SERP overlap (not text similarity), designs hub-and-spoke content clusters with internal link matrices, and generates interactive visualizations. Optionally executes content creation if claude-blog is installed. Use when user says "topic cluster", "content cluster", "semantic clustering", "pillar page", "hub and spoke", "content architecture", "keyword grouping", or "cluster plan".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按搜索意图分组关键词，规划内容集群架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划网站内容架构，需要基于搜索意图组织关键词
copy.tagline_en: Group keywords by search intent and plan content cluster architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning website content architecture and need to organize keywords by search intent

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的种子关键词，通过分析 Google 搜索结果的重叠情况，将关键词分组，设计主题集群（包括支柱页面和辐条页面），生成内部链接矩阵和交互式集群地图。如果安装了 claude-blog 技能，还可以自动创建内容。
howto.when: 当你提到“主题集群”、“内容集群”、“语义聚类”、“支柱页面”、“辐条结构”、“内容架构”、“关键词分组”或“集群计划”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我为“数字营销”做一个主题集群计划。
执行集群计划，创建内容。

say.note: Claude 会读取最新的集群计划并更新交互式地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude expands a seed keyword into variants, groups them by Google SERP overlap, designs hub-and-spoke content clusters with internal link matrices, and generates an interactive cluster map. If claude-blog is installed, it can also create content automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "topic cluster", "content cluster", "semantic clustering", "pillar page", "hub and spoke", "content architecture", "keyword grouping", or "cluster plan".

say_en.text: Create a topic cluster plan for "digital marketing".
Execute the cluster plan and create content.

say_en.note: Claude reads the latest plan and updates the interactive map.
